name: SSL Labs Audit
description: Audit SSL/TLS complet avec note (A+ a F), protocoles, expiration certificat
description_en: Full SSL/TLS audit with a grade (A+ to F), protocols, certificate expiry.
author: ThreatClaw
help: Qualys SSL Labs effectue un audit complet de la configuration SSL/TLS d'un serveur : protocoles supportes, suites de chiffrement, chaine de certificats, expiration, et attribue une note de A+ a F. Aucune cle API requise, API publique gratuite. L'analyse peut prendre 1 a 2 minutes par domaine.
help_en: Qualys SSL Labs performs a full audit of a server's SSL/TLS configuration: supported protocols, cipher suites, certificate chain, expiry, and assigns a grade from A+ to F. No API key required, free public API. The analysis can take 1 to 2 minutes per domain.
